summary: All 10 nodes fail on the required text length criterion - every node has beats exceeding the 150-character limit, with most beats running 160-245 chars. This is a systematic issue from the prose expansion stage that needs a global trim pass. Beat sequence completeness is perfect across all nodes. Tone alignment is excellent throughout: Act 1 hope/frontier grit maintained consistently with no supernatural elements. Historical authenticity is strong - period-appropriate terms (colour, chum, claim shark, duffer, sly grog) used accurately and sparingly. No cliches detected - no saloon brawls, sheriffs, or generic Western tropes. Quality scores range from 68-79, with combat_02 (78) and rest_01 (79) being the strongest nodes and passage_01 (68) the weakest due to thin content. The prose quality itself is genuinely good - strong sensory detail, effective show-don't-tell, clear stakes - but the length violations are uniform and must be fixed before these nodes can pass.
